General Requirements (a) The supplied item shall be brand new, unused and free from manufacturing defects. (b) The product shall conform to the technical specifications stipulated in the bid. (c) The bidder shall clearly mention the make, model number, country of origin and relevant technical deta ils of the offered product. (d) The bidder shall ensure that the complete misting system is supplied with all necessary components an d accessories required for proper functioning. (e) Any variation in the design of the wall-mounting bracket shall be acceptable only if the bracket is comp atible with the fan and provides safe and secure mounting. 3. Technical Compliance and Supporting Documents (a) The bidder shall submit a technical compliance statement confirming compliance with each specificatio n mentioned in the bid. (b) The bidder shall provide the product catalogue, technical datasheet or manufacturer's product literatur e indicating the specifications of the offered model. (c) The purchaser reserves the right to verify the technical specifications and supporting documents submi tted by the bidder. (d) Incomplete technical details or failure to establish compliance with the stipulated specifications may re nder the offer liable for rejection, subject to the applicable GeM bid conditions. 4. Delivery and Installation (a) The item shall be delivered to the consignee location specified in the GeM bid within the stipulated deli very period. (b) The supplier shall ensure safe packaging and transportation to prevent damage during transit. (c) The supplier shall provide the required wall-mounting bracket and all standard accessories necessary fo r installation and operation. (d) Installation, mounting and commissioning, wherever included in the bid, shall be completed by the sup plier without additional charges beyond the accepted contract price. (e) The supplier shall demonstrate the proper functioning of the fan and misting system to the consignee a t the time of acceptance. 5. Inspection and Acceptance

(a) The supplied item shall be inspected by the consignee or an authorised representative. (b) The inspection shall include verification of quantity, physical condition, fan size, motor specifications, s peed settings, misting operation, water flow adjustment, oscillation and supplied accessories. (c) The item shall be accepted only after satisfactory inspection and functional testing. (d) Any item found damaged, defective or materially non-compliant with the accepted specifications shall be replaced or rectified by the supplier in accordance with the contract conditions, at no additional cost to the purchaser. 6. Warranty (a) The supplied fan and its electrical and misting components shall carry a minimum warranty of 12 mont hs from the date of successful delivery and acceptance, or the longer warranty period specified in the GeM bid. (b) During the warranty period, manufacturing defects and failures arising under normal operating conditio ns shall be rectified by the supplier without additional cost to the purchaser. (c) Defective components shall be repaired or replaced by the supplier within a reasonable period in accor dance with the contractual terms. 7. User Instructions and Maintenance (a) The supplier shall provide the user manual and operating instructions, wherever available. (b) Instructions for safe operation, cleaning of misting nozzles, water connections and routine maintenance shall be provided. (c) The supplier shall explain the precautions required for electrical safety and proper connection of the wa ter supply. 8. Payment Payment shall be made as per the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions and the terms stipulated in the bid, subject to satisfactory delivery, inspection and acceptance of the supplied item. 9. General Conditions (a) All applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions shall remain binding on the bidder. (b) The bidder shall comply with applicable statutory requirements, product safety requirements and other conditions specified in the bid. (c) No deviation from the stipulated technical specifications shall be permitted without the purchaser's app roval, wherever such approval is permissible under the applicable procurement rules. (d) In case of any discrepancy, the applicable GeM terms and conditions and the specific provisions of the b id shall prevail. (e) The purchaser reserves the right to take appropriate action against a bidder for submission of false info rmation or documents, in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and conditions and procurement rules . .
